steps.text: Import Path from pathlib.
Import uuid4 from uuid.
Import sqlite3.
Import Image, UnidentifiedImageError from PIL.
Import Flask, request, redirect, render_template, send_from_directory from flask.
Define create_app(database, upload_dir).
Set app to Flask(__name__). Set app.config['MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH'] to 2 * 1024 * 1024.
Set folder to Path(upload_dir).resolve(). Call folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True).
Open a managed context for sqlite3.connect(database) as conn; clean it up on exit.
Execute 'CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Photo(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,title TEXT NOT NULL,filename TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL)'.
Register the following function with app.route('/',methods=['GET','POST']).
Define index().
Check whether request.method equals 'POST'.
Set title to request.form.get('title', '').strip(). Set file to request.files.get('photo').
Check whether not (title) or not (file) or not (file.filename).
Return ('Title and image required', 400).
Try the following steps, with error handling below.
Set image to Image.open(file.stream).
Set format to image.format.
Check whether format is not in ['PNG', 'JPEG'].
Stop this call with ValueError().
Call image.verify(). Call file.stream.seek(0).
Handle (UnidentifiedImageError, OSError, ValueError) rather than stopping the program.
Return ('Use a valid PNG or JPEG', 400).
Set filename to uuid4().hex + ('.png' if format == 'PNG' else '.jpg').
Set path to folder / filename.
Try the following steps, with error handling below.
Call file.save(path).
Open a managed context for sqlite3.connect(database) as conn; clean it up on exit.
Execute 'INSERT INTO Photo(title,filename) VALUES(?,?)' with bound parameters (title, filename).
Handle Exception rather than stopping the program.
Call path.unlink(missing_ok=True).
Re-raise the current exception.
Return redirect('/').
Open a managed context for sqlite3.connect(database) as conn; clean it up on exit.
Set photos to conn.execute('SELECT title,filename FROM Photo ORDER BY id').fetchall().
Return render_template('index.html', photos=photos).
Register the following function with app.get('/photos/<path:name>').
Define photo(name).
Return send_from_directory(folder, name).
Return app.
Check whether __name__ equals '__main__'. Call create_app().run(host='127.0.0.1', port=5052).
